resources.string: Allow your listening interactions and recommendation choices to contribute to shared recommendation model training. Participation is off until you allow it. Your personal statistics and recommendations remain available if you refuse or withdraw.

Withdrawing stops new use and removes related training examples and unfinished work. Already trained shared models continue to work until their normal replacement; withdrawal does not remove past contributions from their weights.
